raw.details:
ZeroBreach 2.0 CTF 2026 is a national-level cybersecurity competition — a 12-hour intense Capture The Flag (CTF) challenge designed for both beginners and pros. Step into the world of cybersecurity and prove your skills across real-world offensive security domains: Web Exploitation, Reverse Engineering, Cryptography, Digital Forensics, OSINT, Steganography, and Miscellaneous challenges.

Open to solo participants or teams of up to 2, ZeroBreach 2.0 offers a ₹20,000 prize pool, verifiable blockchain-powered certificates, and recognition in the Hall of Fame — plus career tools like an AI Resume Builder, AI Interview Prep, and access to the TruScholar Smart Credential Wallet.

Why participate:

  • Real-world cybersecurity challenges
  • National-level competition
  • Boost your problem-solving skills
  • Certificates + Hall of Fame recognition
  • Build a strong cybersecurity portfolio

Event Details

  • Mode: Online
  • Duration: 12 Hours
  • Date: Sep 25, 2026
  • Time: 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM IST
  • Team Size: Solo or up to 2 members
  • Registration Fee: ₹200 per team
  • Flag Format: ZeroCTF{...}

Timeline:

  • Registrations Open: Sep 07, 2026
  • Registration Deadline: Sep 24, 2026, 11:59 PM IST
  • CTF Starts: Sep 25, 2026, 10:00 AM IST
  • CTF Ends: Sep 25, 2026, 10:00 PM IST
  • Writeup Deadline: Sep 28, 2026, 10:00 AM IST
  • Winners Announced: Sep 30, 2026

Domains Covered:

  • Web Exploitation
  • Reverse Engineering
  • Cryptography
  • Digital Forensics
  • OSINT
  • Steganography
  • Miscellaneous Challenges

Prize Pool — ₹20,000:

  • 1st Place — ₹10,000
  • 2nd Place — ₹6,000
  • 3rd Place — ₹4,000
  • 4th–10th — Goodies, Vouchers & Certificates

Sponsorships:

  • TruScholar — Credential & Certificate Partner
  • SpaceCTF — Platform Sponsor
  • Vidyatraa — Community Partner

What Participants Get:

  • Verifiable Blockchain-Powered Certificates
  • Winner Certificates for Top Performers
  • Access to TruScholar Smart Credential Wallet
  • AI Resume Builder & ATS Tools
  • AI Interview Preparation
  • Career & Internship Opportunities

Rules (Quick Highlights):

  • No flag sharing or collaboration between teams
  • Automation allowed (unless restricted per-challenge)
  • No attacks on platform/infrastructure
  • AI tools allowed for solving challenges
  • Flag Format: ZeroCTF{...}

Links:

  • Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/__zerobreach__
  • Organized By: CyberSEC Team

Platform-Specific Notes:

Unstop

  • Category: Competitions & Challenges (Cybersecurity/CTF)
  • Registration on Unstop is mandatory
  • Registration fee: ₹200/team — set this in Unstop's paid-registration settings
  • Team size field: Solo or Duo (max 2)
  • Use the full description above as the event overview; the "Why Participate" and "What Participants Get" sections work well as separate listing highlights if Unstop's form supports bullet sections

CTFtime:

  • Full event name: ZeroBreach 2.0 CTF 2026
  • Format: Jeopardy
  • Online, 12-hour duration (well within the 5-day rating-points window)
  • Organizer team name: confirm CyberSEC Team vs. CyberSpaceVR before submitting via ctftime.org/event/mail
  • Still needed for CTFtime submission: event logo link, official site URL
  • Remember: CTFtime needs a published final scoreboard afterward to award rating points
